raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Pennsylvania Natural Heritage Program note about “the mouths of both Ridley Creek and Crum Creek” along the Delaware River and incorrectly concluded that Crum Creek’s mouth is Ridley Creek. In reality, both creeks have separate mouths into the Delaware River. This error stemmed from over-reliance on an ambiguous snippet, failure to verify with authoritative sources (e.g., USGS/GNIS), and subsequent reinforcement of the incorrect premise.
